fb7a799670ea8fdec3a683b63efe531233485508.reason: Many different projects exist within the same state(s). This FD is nonsensical for the domain and cannot hold except in trivial/single-row datasets.
fb7a799670ea8fdec3a683b63efe531233485508.assumptions: Assumes there is at most one project per state, which is not credible for hydropower projects.
fb7a799670ea8fdec3a683b63efe531233485508.counterexample: State(s)=AL has multiple project names (row 1: MITCHELL; row 10: JORDAN DAM; row 25: COOSA RIVER).

fb7a799670ea8fdec3a683b63efe531233485508.interpretation: Application Type does not determine State(s).
fb7a799670ea8fdec3a683b63efe531233485508.reason: Each application type (e.g., RELICENSE, ORIGINAL LICENSE) can occur in many different states. The observed diversity is expected and reflects domain reality rather than data errors.
fb7a799670ea8fdec3a683b63efe531233485508.assumptions: Assumes each application type is geographically unique (e.g., all RELICENSE entries occur in one state), which is not a meaningful licensing constraint.
fb7a799670ea8fdec3a683b63efe531233485508.counterexample: Application Type=RELICENSE occurs in multiple states (e.g., row 0 CA, row 1 AL, row 7 MD/PA, row 33 ME, row 43 NY).
